args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing (error rate 0.18). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
